content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against a company for violating their rights. The mediator prepares a settlement report and forwards the signed agreement along with such report to the concerned Commission.
content.outcome: The concerned Commission receives the settlement report and the signed agreement, as per the rules of the Act.
